wake-of-gods.mapobjects.battleacademy.de: Train Attack or Defense, learn or improve a combat skill, or buy an artifact. One accepted service per hero per day across all Battle Academies.
wake-of-gods.mapobjects.battleacademy.vi:
{Battle Academy}

You arrive at a huge fortress, but the gate is closed and there's no one to be seen. You think you'd better try tomorrow instead.
wake-of-gods.mapobjects.battleacademy.we:
{Battle Academy}

You come to a huge fortress. Outside it you find a veteran soldier waiting for you. "Welcome to my Battle Academy, hero. Here I have gathered many teachers who can teach you many different skills. I also have an excellent armorsmith who can sell you some battle gear. Do you want to spend some time looking to see if anything interests you?"
wake-of-gods.mapobjects.battleacademy.em:
{Battle Academy}

"You do not have enough gold for any available service, or there is nothing we can teach or sell you today. Maybe some other day, then."
